name: Too Much T.V.
source:
A short and twisted tale of a brother and sister who watch entirely too much television.

The story was originally conceived back in the 1990's and released as a children's tale. The original illustrations were all hand drawn. This version was released in Ren'Py format and uses CGI for all illustrations.

[Edited from [url=http://renai.us/game/too-much-tv.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
一个短小而离奇的故事，讲述了一对看电视看得太多的兄妹。

这个故事最初构思于20世纪90年代，并作为儿童故事发表，当时的插图全部为手绘。这个版本使用Ren’Py制作，全部插图改为计算机生成图像。

（根据[url=http://renai.us/game/too-much-tv.shtml]Ren’Ai档案库[/url]编辑。）
